//overrides: @vscode/test-cli 0.0.15, the latest release, asks for mocha ^11.7.6, and both mocha releases in that range depend on serialize-javascript ^6.0.2 and diff ^7.0.0, which carry GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq (remote code execution through RegExp.flags and Date.prototype.toISOString(), fixed in serialize-javascript 7.0.3), GHSA-qj8w-gfj5-8c6v (CPU exhaustion through crafted array-like objects, fixed in 7.0.5) and GHSA-73rr-hh4g-fpgx (a denial of service in diff's parsePatch and applyPatch, fixed in 8.0.3), with no fix inside either range. mocha 12.0.3, the direct pin, takes serialize-javascript ^7.1.1 and diff ^9.0.0, and this entry hands @vscode/test-cli that same mocha through the $mocha reference, so one copy runs the unit, integration and e2e legs and follows the pin. mocha 12 is outside test-cli's range, so it was verified where test-cli drives Mocha, inside the extension host: the e2e leg passes, full and smoke, on both builds of test/vscode-versions.json. test-cli's runner needs only new Mocha(), addFile() and run(), and its JSON stream reporter Mocha.Runner.constants, all of which mocha 12 keeps. None of these packages reaches the VSIX: .vscodeignore lets in only dist/extension.js, dist/backend.js and the package's own text files. Remove the entry once a @vscode/test-cli release asks for mocha 12: microsoft/vscode-test-cli#118 made that change on 2026-08-31 and is not released yet.
